SELECT n.id, n.type, n.title, n.content, n.source_id, COALESCE(reply_user.nickname, reply_message.nickname) AS author_name, COALESCE(parent_comment.content, parent_message.content) AS original_content, reply_comment.article_id, COALESCE(reply_comment.parent_id, reply_message.parent_id) AS parent_id, CASE WHEN n.type = 'COMMENT_REPLY' THEN reply_comment.like_count ELSE NULL END AS like_count, CASE WHEN n.type = 'COMMENT_REPLY' THEN comment_like.id IS NOT NULL ELSE NULL END AS liked, CASE WHEN n.type = 'COMMENT_REPLY' THEN reply_comment.status = 'APPROVED' AND parent_comment.status = 'APPROVED' AND article.status = 'PUBLISHED' ELSE NULL END AS can_interact, (r.read_at IS NOT NULL) AS read, n.created_at FROM blog_notification_recipient r INNER JOIN blog_notification n ON n.id = r.notification_id LEFT JOIN blog_comment reply_comment ON n.type = 'COMMENT_REPLY' AND reply_comment.id = n.source_id LEFT JOIN blog_comment parent_comment ON parent_comment.id = reply_comment.parent_id LEFT JOIN blog_article article ON article.id = reply_comment.article_id LEFT JOIN blog_comment_like comment_like ON comment_like.comment_id = reply_comment.id AND comment_like.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN blog_user reply_user ON reply_user.id = reply_comment.user_id LEFT JOIN blog_message_board reply_message ON n.type = 'MESSAGE_REPLY' AND reply_message.id = n.source_id LEFT JOIN blog_message_board parent_message ON parent_message.id = reply_message.parent_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND n.type IN ('COMMENT_REPLY', 'MESSAGE_REPLY')
AND n.type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE'
AND n.type = #{type}
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.read_at IS NULL) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.read_at IS NULL AND n.type IN ('COMMENT_REPLY', 'MESSAGE_REPLY')) AS reply, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.read_at IS NULL AND n.type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE') AS admin_message FROM blog_notification_recipient r INNER JOIN blog_notification n ON n.id = r.notification_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT * FROM blog_notification WHERE type = 'ADMIN_MESSAGE' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM blog_notification WHERE id = #{notificationId} FOR UPDATE
